A classic Italian gem in the heart of the Old Town
Oct 2025 • Family
I have been dining at this Italian restaurant with my family since I was a child, and now, as an adult, I returned with my family to celebrate my mother’s birthday. The food is authentic Italian and absolutely delicious. The ambiance is warm, elegant, and classically charming.

The staff still remembered our family, and they were professional, providing detailed advice on what to order and how to enjoy each dish. Highly recommended, especially for its central location in the Old Town.

Does not live up to potential
Apr 2023 • Family
Overpriced Italian restaurant in posh Hanoi district, claims to be 'authentic Italian'. However the pizzas are not homemade and have prefab bottoms, which make them taste like cardboard: hard, chewy and unsavory. They charge European prices for mediocre food, sad! Has more potential but does not live up to it.

Terrible Pizza - money thrown away
Jan 2023 • Couples
Frozen pizza dough with a ton of cheap cheese, you cannot define that pizza. 
The best thing you can do is take the sign “ Italian restaurant “ off. 
The place is nice, even if is full of drunk people it is still a nice atmosphere. 
On the other hand the prices are crazy for Vietnam, we ended up paying over 40 dollar for 2 pizzas and 2 drinks. This is unacceptable given the bad quality of the food. 
As an Italian I feel really ashamed that an italian name is used to make horrible food like this. 
I won’t suggest anyone to go there. Go somewhere else if you are in the mood of authentic Italian food.

Very disappointing experience!
Jun 2022
I have known this restaurant for more than 10 years. The last time I visited was a few years ago and at that time it was very good. Yesterday I went there with my wife and daughter (my daughter had the choice where to go and asked me....I said that it would be a good choice. Unfortunately it was not. The food was very average (not fresh bread, fettuccini dry...), the service was slow and unattending. On top of that it was extremely noisy with a group of men behaving like in a beer garden. Also the staff was not friendly in the encounter. Even when we left no friendly word. So for me this is a no-go because the overall quality is not reflected the price level
